title: Aqila Bakri
gallery_text: The project explores glitching as a method of understanding loopholes in urban infrastructure through investigating NYC sidewalk scaffoldings. The project uses data, mapping, and visualization techniques to examine gaps between regulation, infrastructure, and the live experience.

answers.interest: I am interested in exploring/experimenting alternative forms of representation through simulations and digital twins. I want to investigate how these forms of representation can emphasize/highlight overlooked conditions, reveal loopholes within urban systems, and use data to expose relationships and processes that are often overlooked.
answers.suggestions: I think experimenting with games/alternate reality as tools for to critique existing conditions would be really interesting.
